output.scope_note: The paper is about the Li-ion solid electrolyte La2/3−xLi3xTiO3 (x = 0.13) and reports ionic conductivity numbers, both literature-cited and QENS-derived.

records.measurement_method: quasielastic neutron scattering (QENS) with Nernst-Einstein relation
records.evidence_quote: The spatial average of the σQENS 0.055 ± 0.005 S/cm agrees with that of σLi ∼ 0.1 S/cm at T = 600 K reported from bulk conductivity measurements
records.notes: Conductivity is not measured directly by impedance; it is derived from QENS self-diffusion coefficient via Nernst-Einstein (sigma_QENS). Spatial average of in-plane and out-of-plane values. Single-crystal sample.

records.measurement_method: bulk conductivity measurement (cited from Inaguma et al. [5])
records.evidence_quote: agrees with that of σLi ∼ 0.1 S/cm at T = 600 K reported from bulk conductivity measurements for LLTO with slightly lower Li content (x = 0.11) [5]
records.notes: Value quoted from reference [5] (Inaguma et al.) for LLTO with x = 0.11, not measured in this paper. Approximate value ('∼ 0.1').
